claim_summary: Cast-R1 learns a feedback-conditioned forecasting policy with supervised fine-tuning and curriculum-based multi-turn reinforcement learning, supported by diagnostic tools and a memory-backed forecasting workflow.

claim_evidence.quote:
Conditioned on the updated state, Cast-R1 performs adaptive
model selection by invoking one of several forecasting models exposed as tools.

to train long-horizon forecasting policies.

notes: The fixed three-stage scaffold still conditions model selection and refinement on returned diagnostics and forecasts. Memory is TSK because the detailed implementation is tied to forecast-result availability and forecasting stages. The analytical toolkit is GTS; predictive model integration belongs to the TSK workflow, and unchanged forecasters are not standalone contributions. Process evidence is a qualitative execution case, not a tool-success benchmark. Declared look-back/horizon lengths and raw-scale MSE/MAE do not establish a chronological split or information-availability audit. No downstream decision utility is evaluated. Main-text backbone/hardware (Qwen3-8B/four A800s, lines 617-619) conflicts with Appendix C (Qwen3-1.7B/one RTX 4090D, lines 1604-1607); this does not change the mechanism classification. The stage-aware prompt construction (App. D.2) overlaps with forecast-workflow; it is kept in state-memory (storage plus context assembly) because Section 3.2 presents it separately.
